full_page.content:
1932, January
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. S.
Page 18 Cont.
Jan. 22 Robert Bushta - 5 - Ward Ave .- never walked - tries to speak. Delia Jibulo 57 (about) nervous breakdown
Mrs. H. Hurlett - 46 - threatened with cancer of stomach - from throat down.
Page 19
Jan. 24 Dorothy Haggan - 3 - To-day never spoke - never sat up - yet bright and smiling.
Mrs. Eliz. Eggers - 69 - mental -
Francis Conway - 31 - cancer of stomach - operated in Ford's Wm. Hirschman - away from his family 17 months - they are anxious Jos Fitzpatrich - student Latin discouraging Leander Van Petghan 11 days on back helpless -u
John Butler - 13 - fainting spells Mrs ... Infected Eye .... a Cath. Mrs - in Ontario Asylum
Ernest Stesger - 42 - of Iowa - 6 in family - given up as hopeless now improving ....
Page 20 Jan. Mrs. Van Hevel - 74 - stroke - terrible pain for 5 months. Mrs. Stella - 47 - Goiter pray
Jan. 31 Cath. Sears Kidder - 21 - Kidney & lungs
Mrs. Matilda Joynes (38 Petowski Ave.) in accident 6 yrs. ago - had back badly -
1932, February
February Feb. 2 -4 a.m. - John Tuis about 30 - fearfully swollen neck Mrs. Jones .... prayed for everyone whose case she hears mentioned here. . . ..
